description: This file defines the JwtTokenGenerator class responsible for creating JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) for authentication purposes within the application. It constructs JWTs with claims and signs them based on provided options.

classes.name: JwtTokenGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating JWTs with user claims and security credentials.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates and signs a JWT containing the username and relevant claims.
